name: Companion Charge
text: The Companions hit like a thunderbolt; the line bends and breaks.

name: Phalanx
text: Sarissas level; the wall of bronze advances and does not stop.

name: Siege Ladder
text: Timbers, rope, and nerve — a wall is only a door not yet opened.

name: Bucephalus
text: The great black horse fears only his own shadow — and you ride him anyway.

name: Royal Decree
text: A seal, a scribble, and the provinces remit their tribute.

name: Wedge Formation
text: A spearhead of horse and foot, driven where the enemy line is thinnest.
